name: Willful Sin
overview: Scripture distinguishes between sin committed in ignorance and willful sin, emphasizing the serious consequences of the latter. While unintentional sins could be atoned for with offerings (Numbers 15:27), willful sin after receiving the knowledge of the truth leaves no further sacrifice available (Hebrews 10:26). Believers are called to walk in the Spirit to avoid fulfilling the lusts of the flesh (Galatians 5:16, 5:24) and to choose obedience to righteousness rather than slavery to sin (Romans 6:16). God sets before us clear choices of life and death, urging us to choose life and good (Deuteronomy 30:15).
